content: Consuming protein at a level of 2.5 grams per kilogram of body weight per day, or approximately 15-20% of total daily caloric intake, has been shown to improve health outcomes in individuals with diabetes. Protein intake recommendations should be tailored to each individual, taking into account their specific dietary patterns and personal health needs. Some research suggests that slightly higher protein consumption, in the range of 20-30% of total daily calories, may assist in the management of type 2 diabetes and contribute to increased feelings of satiety.
